name: A Sealed Crate
summary: A trader asks you to bring in a sealed crate amid a rise in banditry along the trade routes. Other crates found along the way can be brought here for the same handling.

sections.title: Trade Goods
sections.body: Bandits and thieves have begun intercepting trade routes, and a trader asks you to bring a sealed crate to the pile. The trader thanks you for the delivery and says other crates can be brought here for them to handle. Trade goods remain at risk along the routes.

faq.q: What do I do with the sealed crate?
faq.answer: Bring the crate to the trader, who will place it by the pile.
Bandits and thieves have been intercepting trade routes lately.

faq.q: Can I bring other crates here?
faq.answer: Yes. The trader says to bring other crates here, and they will handle them.

faq.q: What does the trader give me?
faq.answer: The trader offers you payment for your work.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Sealed Crate
